Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment and any signs of stabilization in the chip sector.

Bottom line: You're in a tough spot with these leveraged names; focus on managing risk and protecting capital.
plays: Trim SMCI if it breaks below $32.50.
Consider trimming SOXL if it shows no signs of life near current levels.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
